title: Dimensional stability of additively manufactured diagnostic maxillary casts: Influence of cast-base design, PLA filament type, infill density, and storage duration
html: The choice of materials and printing strategies in dental cast fabrication may influence accuracy. Evidence regarding the impact of different cast base designs, various polylactic acid (PLA) filaments, and printing processes on the dimensional stability of additively manufactured (AM) diagnostic maxillary casts is lacking.
